conventions.kappa: odd central, kappa^2 = 0, written on the LEFT: [X,Y]_gb = [X,Y]_0 + kappa*gamma(X,Y)
conventions.basis: normal-ordered quadratic monomials (order a+ < a- < b1+ < b1- < ...); g taken modulo C*1
conventions.up_to_scalar: equalities are in g = (quadratic span)/C*1, i.e. in the adjoint representation
